mentions.name: Weblegit
mentions.description: This platform makes it easier to build simple web applications by hosting static content with built-in authentication functionality to keep the content secure and dynamic. For enterprise customers, it solves multi-tenancy for SaaS businesses when it comes to authentication.
mentions.problem: Authentication is almost always built as just another feature, even though it is THE feature that gates all other features.
mentions.audience: For enterprise customers and SaaS businesses needing authentication tenancy solutions.
mentions.source_excerpt: Making it easier to build simple web applications, host your static content with in built authentication functionality to make your content secure and dynamic. For enterprise customers, solving the tenancy for SAAS businesses when it comes to authentication.
